workstreams.overrideReason: Rare-earth permanent magnets are the defining node of SC-MAGNETS and the shared problem of this workstream: direct-drive and medium-speed permanent-magnet turbines are among the most magnet-intensive uses. The demand split is a tie; filing it under SC-WIND would leave the magnets compact without the workstream that holds its magnets. Wind turbine generating sets stay on the SC-WIND spine, and SC-WIND shows the workstream as also touching it.

Li-ion cells and packs are the end of the battery chain and the reason the workstream exists; electric buses and trucks are the cell-intensive vehicles that share its partners. Under Managed Interdependence the cells are its only active node.

The workstream is the motor -> hermetic compressor -> heat pump and air-conditioner chain, which the large HVAC makers integrate in-house; its partners (Japan, Thailand, Mexico, Korea) are that appliance base. Two of its three nodes are SC-HEAT's, the motor node is a generic heading of which compressor motors are a part, and under Managed Interdependence its only active node is heat pumps. Filing it under SC-MAGNETS on the demand split would leave SC-HEAT's two largest BUILD nodes outside its own workstreams; SC-MAGNETS keeps its motor-making workstream (AIB-C06, NGO steel and motor parts) and electric motors stay on its spine.
